preconditions.description: The size of the chessboard n is between 1 and 500 inclusive.
The length of the permutation list p is equal to n.
The permutation list p contains each integer from 1 to n exactly once.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == n and all(len(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()) == i + 1 for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or consists of n lines where the i-th line contains i+1 numbers.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(1 <= int(x) <= n for line in stdout.splitlines() for x in line.split())
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', each number in the output is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i - 1].split()[0]) == p[i - 1] for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the first number in the i-th line is equal to p[i-1].

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(len([x for line in stdout.splitlines()[:i] for x in line.split() if int(x) == j]) == j for i in range(1, n + 1) for j in range(1, i + 1))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the number of occurrences of j in the first i lines is equal to j.
